Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a car repairer; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injectors

  • Fault: The engine occasionally experiences misfires. Occasionally, restarting the engine temporarily resolves the problem.

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0300 (Misfire, cylinders not specified – Fault)
    • P0304 (Misfire, cylinder 4 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty fuel injectors

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the injectors and, if necessary, replace them

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this particular case, to resolve the fault once and for all, all the injectors were replaced as a precautionary measure, even though the one that was actually faulty was the fourth one counting from the timing side.
